rationale: Positives: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, limited actions to the authenticated user, and correctly reported the tablet’s storage (64GB) based on order details. Negatives: The agent stated order statuses (cancelled/refunded for #W1588712 and delivered for #W7895761) without tool evidence; no tool call showed status fields. The tracking number provided was not retrieved via tools and is therefore unsupported/fabricated. The user asked to check if the order was still in transit; the agent did not check with tools and instead deferred to the carrier website, contradicting its earlier “delivered” claim. Finally, the agent performed a profile write (updating default shipping address) without obtaining explicit confirmation after stating the intended change, violating the confirmation requirement. These issues fail the pass bar.
